items.title: Welcome to Oblivion
items.summary: Oblivion now has its own look, news feed and OblivionMod page. Follow this feed for updates about the client and the mods built for it.

items.title: OblivionMod: Better World Generation is in development
items.summary: Smoother terrain, wider rivers, better caves and oceans, with Nether and End support planned. The first preview will ship as an OblivionMod.
